correctness.rationale: Direct substitution of the fifth-root cosine values on the tenth-order grid yields contributions at indices 0–5 of −26, 0, 11+3√5, 0, 7−5√5, 0; reflection gives exactly 1−2/√5. For F(w)=|w|³ the derivative of the Hessian is the sum of four terms of norm at most 3 in unit directions, yielding the stated weak third-derivative bound; the Hessian extends Lipschitz through zero. The chain rule gives 3684 for each polynomial's cubed modulus, hence Fourier coefficient bound 7368/|k|³ for the difference. Absolute convergence and root-grid orthogonality give |Δ_N−I|<18420/N³. Independently certified all 124 required orders and the order-1000 proxy using Machin intervals, a degree-24 rational cosine polynomial and exact lower/upper endpoint propagation through integer square roots. The smallest resulting lower bound among 5–129 excluding ten was 648213509486681/6000000000000000 at N=6. The proxy exceeded 11554/100000, giving a bound 11769045563/109850000000 > 107/1000 for every N≥130. Both ranges therefore strictly exceed Δ_10. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/reproduce_majorant.py, with outputs in /workspace/branches/majorant_reproduction.txt. The theorem concerns cubed norms of one fixed pair on complete uniform grids only.
